phrase: I host my giveaways mainly on my Discord.
howToEnter: Go to #giveaway-requirements, complete the requirements and post your proof screenshots there.
Once your screenshots are posted, the bot gives you the Giveaway Ready role automatically.
With that role, go to #giveaways and click the 🎉 button on the current giveaway.
ifYouWin: After each giveaway you have 48 hours to open a ticket, ping me and tell me you won the giveaway.
If you do not redeem the reward before the 48 hours, I will be forced to reroll you and choose another winner.
The ticket channel is in the Entry Gate category.
If somebody tells you that person is jacktradesnq in DM, do NOT believe him. I will not DM you first.
